summary: Finding 12d: DuckDB's avg(BIGINT) may double-round on x86-64 Linux, so the claim 'no error below 2^53' is false and semantics='duckdb' may prove a row set Linux does not return.
note: Ruling 71 withdrew this remark for the shipped wheel; ruling 74 restores it for native shapes: the DuckDB profile's avg(BIGINT) allows more than one double.
